## Description
This figure illustrates two neural network architectures for word representation learning: Continuous Bag of Words (CBOW) and Skip-gram. The CBOW model predicts the current word based on its context, while the Skip-gram model predicts the surrounding words given the current word. Both models use a projection layer to map words to vectors.
